ns2:course.label: Special Courses
ns2:course.description: Experimental and temporary courses. 1 to 5 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
